claims.assertion: Anéeka identifies Puma Punku as a 12,000-year-old multiracial Federation starbase, later inhabited by successive human cultures and covered with portal maps.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says stones were cut using sound and gravity; Sun Gate portal use requires exact stellar timing, spacecraft, and powerful computers.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Usungal reptilians built Machu Picchu for human followers and dates it about 3,000 years before Puma Punku.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes the Sun as a gravity-based portal transit hub; ships jump frequencies by manipulating gravity rather than bending space.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
